lesson_1.title: Catch Mr. X
lesson_1.body: Your goal is to catch Mr. X before round 8 ends. Land on his station to win.
lesson_1.why: If Mr. X stays free through round 8, he wins the match.

lesson_1.title: Turn Order
lesson_1.body: Mr. X moves first in secret. Then each detective takes their turn in order.
lesson_1.why: Watching who moves helps you track each detective closing in.

lesson_1.title: Your Detective
lesson_1.body: This is you at Station 18. You are Detective 1 leading the hunt.
lesson_1.why: Keep track of your position to coordinate with your partner.

lesson_1.title: Moving by Taxi
lesson_1.body: Yellow roads are taxi routes. Tap glowing Station 22 to travel there.
lesson_1.why: Taxis connect almost all stations and move one stop.
lesson_1.confirm: Nice! You traveled by taxi to Station 22.

lesson_1.title: Ticket Costs
lesson_1.body: Every move costs a ticket: yellow taxi, green bus, pink underground.
lesson_1.why: Run out of a ticket type and you cannot use that transport anymore.

lesson_1.title: Choose Transport
lesson_1.body: Station 10 connects by taxi and bus. Tap Station 10, then pick a ticket.
lesson_1.why: Choosing wisely saves your rarer tickets for when you need them.
lesson_1.confirm: Great choice! You picked your transport ticket to Station 10.

lesson_1.title: River Ferry
lesson_1.body: The river route from Station 16 to 19 is a ferry. Only Mr. X can ride it.
lesson_1.why: Detectives cannot use ferries, giving Mr. X a river escape route.

lesson_1.title: Blocked Stations
lesson_1.body: Detectives cannot stand on the same station. Occupied stations are blocked.
lesson_1.why: Use your partner's position to wall off Mr. X's exit routes.

lesson_1.title: Travel Log
lesson_1.body: Mr. X moves in secret. The log records which ticket he used each round.
lesson_1.why: A bus ticket means he can only be at connected bus stops.

lesson_1.title: Reveal Rounds
lesson_1.body: Mr. X surfaces on fixed rounds. Red marker shows his last seen station.
lesson_1.why: Rounds 2, 5, and 8 reveal his exact location to all detectives.

lesson_1.title: Track His Trail
lesson_1.body: From his last seen station, trace where his ticket could take him.
lesson_1.why: Surround his possible escape stations before he slips away again.

lesson_1.title: Spotlight Tells
lesson_1.body: The spotlight shows where Mr. X looked on the map during his turn.
lesson_1.why: Read his gaze to anticipate his direction, but watch out for bluffs.

lesson_1.title: Stuck Detectives
lesson_1.body: If a detective has no legal moves or runs out of tickets, they skip.
lesson_1.why: Always preserve enough tickets to stay mobile throughout the match.

lesson_1.title: Ways to Lose
lesson_1.body: Detectives lose if Mr. X survives round 8, or if all detectives get stuck.
lesson_1.why: Keep the pressure on and corner him before rounds run out.

lesson_1.title: Catch Mr. X!
lesson_1.body: Now close in and land on Mr. X's station to catch him!
lesson_1.why: Trap him against the river and blocked stations to win.

lesson_2.title: Moving in Secret
lesson_2.body: Now you are Mr. X! Detectives see your ticket choices, never your position.
lesson_2.why: Keep them guessing by alternating between taxi, bus, and underground.

lesson_2.title: Black Tickets
lesson_2.body: Black tickets hide which transport you used and allow you to ride the ferry.
lesson_2.why: Use black tickets on the ferry or right after a reveal to vanish.

lesson_2.title: Double Move
lesson_2.body: Double move lets you travel twice in one turn. You have limited cards.
lesson_2.why: Use it to break out of a trap or put huge distance between you.

lesson_2.title: Surrendered Tickets
lesson_2.body: Every ticket detectives spend is surrendered directly into your hand!
lesson_2.why: As detectives run low on tickets, your own stash continues growing.

lesson_2.title: Surfacing at Round 2
lesson_2.body: On round 2 you must surface. Move far away immediately on your next turn.
lesson_2.why: Detectives will rush toward your red marker as soon as it appears.

lesson_2.title: Close Your Eyes
lesson_2.body: With spotlight tells on, use Close Eyes to hide your gaze for a turn.
lesson_2.why: Your camera is your eyes. Closing them leaves detectives with zero clues.

lesson_2.title: Camera Tells
lesson_2.body: Where you pan your camera is where detectives see your spotlight gaze.
lesson_2.why: Look across the city at a false station to lure detectives away from you.

lesson_2.title: Winning as Mr. X
lesson_2.body: Survive all 6 rounds or strand all detectives to win the game!
lesson_2.why: Outsmart the detectives and escape into the London night.
